title: Ethiopian Chicken Curry
description: A flavorful and spicy curry made with chicken, onions, and a blend of Ethiopian spices. Perfect for a quick and delicious dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the curry powder and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Return the chicken to the skillet and cook until cooked through.
Stir in the sour cream and season with salt and pepper.
Serve hot over rice or with naan bread.
